parameters.query:
WITH p AS (
 SELECT $1::bigint AS id, LOWER(BTRIM($2::text)) AS code,
 REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE($3::text,''),'\D','','g') AS phone
), m AS (
 SELECT o.* FROM public.orders o CROSS JOIN p
 WHERE o.id=p.id AND LOWER(BTRIM(o.order_code))=p.code
 AND REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(o.customer_phone,''),'\D','','g')=p.phone
), imgs AS (
 SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id',oi.id,'imageType',oi.image_type,'objectKey',oi.object_key,'fileName',oi.file_name,'mimeType',oi.mime_type,'fileSizeBytes',oi.file_size_bytes) ORDER BY oi.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS items
 FROM public.order_images oi JOIN m ON m.id=oi.order_id WHERE oi.is_active=TRUE AND oi.deleted_at IS NULL
)
SELECT (m.id IS NOT NULL) AS matched,
 CASE WHEN m.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE m.id END AS order_id,
 CASE WHEN m.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE m.order_code END AS order_code,
 imgs.items AS current_images
FROM (SELECT 1) s LEFT JOIN m ON TRUE CROSS JOIN imgs;

WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
valid AS (
 SELECT o.id FROM public.orders o,d
 WHERE o.id=(d.j->>'orderId')::bigint
 AND LOWER(BTRIM(o.order_code))=LOWER(BTRIM(d.j->>'orderCode'))
 AND REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(o.customer_phone,''),'\D','','g')=REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(d.j->>'originalPhone',''),'\D','','g')
 FOR UPDATE
), upd AS (
 UPDATE public.orders o SET
 customer_name=d.j->>'name', customer_phone=d.j->>'phone', moderator_name=NULLIF(d.j->>'moderatorName',''),
 fulfillment_method=d.j->>'fulfillmentMethod', city=NULLIF(d.j->>'city',''), area=NULLIF(d.j->>'area',''), address_details=NULLIF(d.j->>'addressDetails',''),
 delivery_date=NULLIF(d.j->>'deliveryDate','')::date, delivery_time_from=NULLIF(d.j->>'deliveryTimeFrom',''), delivery_time_to=NULLIF(d.j->>'deliveryTimeTo',''),
 cake_type=d.j->>'cakeType', cake_size=d.j->>'cakeSize',
 dimensions=CASE WHEN NULLIF(d.j->>'dimensions','') IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN LEFT(BTRIM(d.j->>'dimensions'),1) IN ('{','[') THEN (d.j->>'dimensions')::jsonb ELSE TO_JSONB(d.j->>'dimensions') END,
 number_of_tiers=NULLIF(d.j->>'numberOfTiers','')::integer, filling=NULLIF(d.j->>'filling',''), covering=NULLIF(d.j->>'covering',''), details=NULLIF(d.j->>'details',''),
 base_price_egp=COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'basePriceEGP','')::numeric,0), cake_design_extra_egp=COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'cakeDesignExtraEGP','')::numeric,0),
 addons_total_egp=COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'addOnsTotalEGP','')::numeric,0), delivery_fee_egp=COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'deliveryFeeEGP','')::numeric,0),
 discount_type=COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'discountType',''),'none'), discount_input_value=COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'discountInputValue','')::numeric,0),
 discount_amount_egp=COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'discountAmountEGP','')::numeric,0), total_order_egp=COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'totalOrderEGP','')::numeric,0),
 deposit_egp=COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'depositEGP','')::numeric,0), remaining_egp=COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'remainingEGP','')::numeric,0),
 order_summary=NULLIF(d.j->>'orderSummary',''), order_status = CASE
    WHEN d.j->>'orderStatus' IN ('تم التأكيد', 'قيد التأكيد', 'ملغي')
    THEN d.j->>'orderStatus'
    WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(d.j->>'depositEGP','')::numeric, 0) > 0
    THEN 'تم التأكيد'
    ELSE 'قيد التأكيد'
END, updated_at=NOW()
 FROM d,valid WHERE o.id=valid.id RETURNING o.id,o.order_code
), del_addons AS (DELETE FROM public.order_addons WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM upd)),
ins_addons AS (
 INSERT INTO public.order_addons(order_id,product_id,product_name,unit,quantity,unit_price_egp,design_extra_egp,total_egp)
 SELECT u.id,NULLIF(a->>'productId',''),a->>'productName',COALESCE(NULLIF(a->>'unit',''),'unit'),COALESCE(NULLIF(a->>'quantity','')::numeric,1),COALESCE(NULLIF(a->>'unitPriceEGP','')::numeric,0),COALESCE(NULLIF(a->>'designExtraEGP','')::numeric,0),COALESCE(NULLIF(a->>'totalEGP','')::numeric,0)
 FROM upd u CROSS JOIN d CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(COALESCE(d.j->'addOns','[]'::jsonb)) a RETURNING id
), removed AS (
 UPDATE public.order_images oi SET is_active=FALSE,deleted_at=NOW()
 FROM upd u,d
 WHERE oi.order_id=u.id AND oi.is_active=TRUE AND oi.deleted_at IS NULL
 AND NOT ((oi.image_type='cake' AND (d.j->'imagesToKeep'->'cake') ? oi.id::text) OR (oi.image_type='deposit' AND (d.j->'imagesToKeep'->'deposit') ? oi.id::text))
 RETURNING oi.id,oi.image_type,oi.object_key
)
SELECT u.id AS order_id,u.order_code,'success'::text AS status,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ins_addons)::int AS addons_saved,
 COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id',id,'imageType',image_type,'objectKey',object_key)) FROM removed),'[]'::jsonb) AS removed_images
FROM upd u;

DELETE FROM public.order_images
WHERE id = $1::bigint
  AND order_id = $2::bigint
  AND is_active = FALSE
  AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
RETURNING
    id AS deleted_image_id,
    order_id;

parameters.query:
WITH target_order AS (
    SELECT id, order_code
    FROM public.orders
    WHERE order_code = $1
), deleted AS (
    DELETE FROM public.order_telegram_messages m
    USING target_order o
    WHERE m.order_id = o.id
    RETURNING m.id
)
SELECT order_code AS "Code"
FROM target_order;

SELECT
    o.order_code,
    m.telegram_chat_id,
    m.telegram_message_id,
    m.message_type,
    m.created_at
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.order_telegram_messages m
    ON m.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.order_code = $1
ORDER BY m.created_at ASC;

SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_code, o.order_status, ods.sheet_name, ds.sheet_id AS old_sheet_id, ods.row_number AS old_row_number
FROM public.orders o
JOIN public.order_delivery_sheets ods ON ods.order_id = o.id
JOIN public.delivery_sheets ds ON ds.sheet_name = ods.sheet_name
WHERE o.order_code = $1
LIMIT 1;
